escena: SCENE (staged, Efeonce studio at night, right after a campaign went live): a Chilean growth strategist in her early thirties, dark hair tied back, plain charcoal knit, stands behind a dark walnut table and looks straight into the lens with a confident, amused half-smile, caught at the exact moment she turns an open laptop toward the camera; the laptop screen glows cool white-blue and is the brightest thing near her. A hard low key light from the far left rakes across her face, one side of her face in open shadow; a second low source behind her right shoulder cuts a rim on her hair and shoulder and its beam crosses a thin haze BELOW the middle of the frame. One plain azure-blue (#0375DB) notebook on the table carries the only blue. Bare dark wall, no plants, no books, no framed art. 85mm f/2. Screen content soft and abstract, no readable text, unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the dark walnut table, dissolved into blur and outside every beam

texto.muro: the calm, evenly shadowed bare dark wall
